set.tovw: Lead grade D (treasure thread): legend only; 1905 find a hoax
set.st: Two stories: (1) 1850, two Germans' land-payment gold vanished from a schooner and was said buried on the stony beach (one 1940 AP feature; legend only); (2) a 1905 wire story that $150,000 in Chicago-fire Spanish gold was dug up here was a hoax invented by a Northport joker. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
set.n: North Fox Island: German land-payment gold (1850 legend) and the 1905 hoax find
